name: Ecosia
summary:
Ecosia is the search engine at ecosia.org that funds tree planting. Its tab icon is a small green mark, and the copy here is whatever that host returned on the check date.

Checked 12 November 2026 against ecosia.org. HTML came from https://www.ecosia.org/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.ecosia.org/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.ecosia.org/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 webp.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-180x180-01.webp at 180×180 (webp, 658 bytes) from https://www.ecosia.org/apple-touch-icon.png.
